name: Rite
title: RITE - Not your momma’s workout app!
description: RITE is a raw, offline-first, minimalist workout app built for fighters, survivors, and real-world readiness. It’s not bloated with distractions, levels, or smart AI. It’s designed to get users training fast—whether they’re doing pushups in a tiny apartment, sprinting stairs in an alley, or sparring in the park.
author: Michael Schwartz
